summary: Enhance your skills in financial reporting with our course on preparing financial statements and annual reports. Join us to learn from industry experts!
lede: Financial reporting training helps experienced finance professionals turn accounting data into financial statements and annual reports. It is designed for reporting managers, financial controllers and senior accountants, with practical work in group consolidation, asset impairment and deferred tax calculations, as well as preparing and reviewing annual report disclosures.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced finance professionals who are responsible for the accuracy, compliance, and presentation of corporate financial data to internal and external stakeholders.
modules: Financial Reporting Frameworks and IAS 1 Presentation
Revenue Recognition and Lease Accounting Excellence
Cash Flow Dynamics and Equity Reporting
Income Tax Accounting and Deferred Tax Assets
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in accounting or finance roles. Familiarity with basic financial statement structures and a working knowledge of Excel for financial modeling are required. Prior exposure to IFRS or local GAAP is highly recommended.
